purpose: Universal audio-reactive bridge material function consuming MPC_Melodia_Palette parameters (BeatPulse, Bass, Mid, Treble, BeatPhase, BeatIntensity, GlobalReactivity, RhythmPulse) to drive surface materials with continuous, artifact-free, clamped musical synesthesia.
authoring_rules: single-writer authority: UMelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem is the sole writer of MPC_Melodia_Palette; this function is strictly a read-only consumer
clamped bounds: all emissive multipliers, roughness offsets, and color lifts are clamped to physically safe ranges [0.0, 5.0] to prevent blowout or NaN errors

neutral defaults: when audio input is quiescent or disabled (GlobalReactivity = 0.0), output perfectly preserves baseline artist values (1.0x color, 0.0x additional emissive, 0.0x normal perturbation)
vertex & pixel safe: expressions are fully compatible with both Substrate FrontMaterial pipelines and legacy shading models

EmissiveGain.desc: Scalar multiplier for beat-driven emissive pulsing

PulseCurveExp.desc: Exponent shaping beat pulse response curve

NormalPerturb.desc: Audio ripple micro-perturbation for surface normals
